verdicts.evidence: lines 601-644: every button (Check contacts, Try again, Import, Edit contacts, both downloads, Show more, Stop import, Import the remaining, Import more contacts, Fix skipped rows) has a listener that does what its label names
lines 404-435, 441-490, 533-561: all rows, counts and problem texts derive from the user's CSV and api.validateImport/runImport results; no hardcoded sample values or placeholder text
lines 444-463, 468-485: review step shows every parsed row, its problems and the good/bad counts beside the Import button; lines 499-502, 540-549: run step shows imported-of-goal and skipped counts

lines 268-271, 604-605, 658: textarea text saved to sessionStorage on input and restored on reload; lines 646-653: Back keeps the text, Forward restores review if still valid; lines 415-421: a failed check leaves the text; 550-552: failed import keeps remaining rows

line 435: preselected filter is a view-only choice; lines 136, 601: the only Enter-submittable action is Check contacts, which validates and imports nothing; import buttons are type=button and focus goes to headings (386, 564), not to them
lines 117-196: add, check and import run as three in-page views with no dialogs; the review step between is required by the brief; choosing a file runs the check automatically (line 597)

lines 111-196: file/paste input, check, problem table with filter, import with progress/stop and outcome all map to the brief; the downloads and Fix skipped rows (147, 191-192) serve handling the problem rows; no stat cards, feeds or tips

line 136: one primary in edit view; lines 455-457: Edit contacts becomes primary only when Import is hidden; lines 554-556: resume-btn and new-btn are both primary but mutually exclusive (hidden = !left vs !!left)
No action deletes or overwrites saved data. Import adds records, Stop import (631-637) halts and can be resumed, and the textarea is only cleared after a completed import (543)

lines 409-410, 634-635: the only disabled states are aria-disabled on Check contacts and Stop import while their own request is in flight, each with a busy label; unavailable buttons are hidden instead (455, 458, 554-560)
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in lines 109-199 or in the script
lines 110-198, 366-377, 441-463, 540-561: all visible text is about contacts, rows and the import; nothing mentions the implementation, the brief or simulated data

line 127: format hint sits at the textarea; lines 448-452: note that problem rows will be skipped sits above the Import button; line 416: 'Nothing has been imported' in the failure notice by Try again. No other notices

lines 121-136: labels, one short hint at the textarea and a button; no sentence narrates the page or its controls. Line 448 guidance names the next step for an all-problem file, at the Edit contacts button

line 118: step h2 is screen-reader only so it does not repeat the step list; line 127 hint adds the column rule to its label; lines 451-452 and 545-548 add skipped/saved facts to the count heading rather than rewording it
lines 110-198, 441-463, 540-549: headings and messages are plain statements ('Import contacts', '12 contacts imported'); no greetings, slogans, exclamation marks or congratulations

lines 133, 136, 146, 183, 190, 456, 459, 489, 555, 558, 561: 'Check contacts', 'Try again', 'Import 237 contacts', 'Edit contacts', 'Download the 3 rows with problems', 'Show 100 more', 'Stop import', 'Import the remaining 190', 'Fix the 3 skipped rows'

lines 366-372: server codes REQUIRED/EMAIL_FORMAT/PHONE_FORMAT/DUPLICATE_IN_CRM are mapped to 'Name is missing', 'Already in the CRM' etc; lines 373-377: error codes mapped to sentences; column headers 160-165 are plain words

lines 373-377, 416: 'The contacts could not be checked. The connection to the server dropped. Nothing has been imported.' with Try again; lines 545-548, 555: interrupted import states cause, saved count and 'Import the remaining N'; raw e.message never shown

lines 310-332, 366-377, 416, 545, 584-593: wording is 'could not be checked', 'Import interrupted', 'is missing', 'is not a valid address'; none of the listed words, no exclamation marks or capitals, and the subject is the file or row
lines 309-310, 332: zero contacts is rejected as a field error before review; line 460, 469: the filter only shows when both good and bad rows exist, so the table can never render with zero rows
lines 460, 469: the review table cannot be empty for any reason (filter hidden unless both groups are non-empty; a failed check never reaches the review view, lines 415-418)

lines 131-134, 415-421, 602: failed check shows a notice in the form with Try again and leaves the textarea intact; lines 526-530, 545-555: failed import states it, keeps saved count, offers 'Import the remaining N' and writes unimported rows back (550)

lines 408-411: Check button gets a spinner and 'Checking N rows...' immediately; lines 180-183, 499-502, 517-521: import shows a progress bar, 'N of M contacts imported' and a Stop import button wired to AbortController (631-637)
There is no empty state: the review view is only rendered and shown after validateImport resolves (lines 423-438), and the table cannot be empty (460, 469)

lines 79-81: table-layout fixed with overflow-wrap anywhere; line 333: absent cells become '' so no undefined; line 476: flagged empty cells read 'missing'; lines 251, 470, 486-489: 100 rows at a time with Show more; line 263: numbers formatted; 63: buttons wrap
lines 604-605, 658: the pasted text is stored on every input and restored on return or reload; line 654: beforeunload prompts while an import is running; line 648: Back is blocked during an import

lines 121, 126-128: label 'Choose a CSV file' and hint 'First line: name, email, phone, company. Name and email are required.' are visible before input. The 5 MB guard (586) is stated only on error but is far above the brief's few hundred rows
lines 120-130: the form has one logical input offered two ways ('Choose a CSV file' / 'Or paste CSV text'); there is no mix of required and optional fields to tell apart
lines 400-405, 601: validation runs only on submit (or after a file is chosen); lines 604-607: the input handler never sets an error and clears the existing one as soon as the user types

line 582-593: file errors (spreadsheet not CSV, over 5 MB, unreadable) are written to #csv-error under the textarea (line 129) and the textarea is marked invalid, not beside the file input they concern (122-123). Textarea errors themselves are adjacent with border and 'Problem:' text
lines 389-397, 403-405: client rejection only shows the error and leaves the textarea value; lines 415-421: a server failure restores the button and readOnly state without touching the text

lines 389-392, 128: textarea errors focus the field, set aria-invalid and are in its aria-describedby. But line 582 focuses #file on a file error while setting aria-invalid on the textarea; #file's aria-describedby is file-status only (122), so the message is not tied to it

line 136: submit is never disabled up front; line 403: pressing it empty shows 'Paste CSV text or choose a CSV file.' and focuses the textarea; lines 409, 421: aria-disabled only during its own request

lines 401, 408-410: check() returns if already checking and the button shows a busy label; lines 494, 505: startFromReview and runImport return if importing, and the view switches to progress at once (513)

lines 408-410: Check shows spinner label synchronously; 508-513: Import switches to the progress view before awaiting; 634-635: Stop shows 'Stopping...'; 621-629: filter and Show more re-render at once; 357-363: downloads start immediately
lines 441-454: check result stated in the review heading; lines 539-549: outcome heading states imported, stopped or interrupted with counts; lines 416-417: failures always shown

line 595: 'Loaded <file name>' names the file, which is otherwise not visible because the input is cleared (603); line 540: 'N contacts imported' is the result itself, not a toast confirming something already on screen

lines 129, 131-134, 186-193: errors render in place in the form or the outcome panel; no setTimeout dismisses any message (only timers are line 266 live-region fill and 362 URL revoke); errors clear on typing or retry (402, 606)

lines 631-637: Stop import runs at once with no confirmation and the outcome offers 'Import the remaining N' (554-555, 638); lines 617-619, 649: Edit contacts goes back without a prompt and Forward returns to the review
No action permanently deletes or overwrites data, sends an unrecallable message or spends money; import adds contacts after a review step that lists them (441-466)
line 654: the only confirmation is the browser's leave prompt, raised only while an import is in progress; no confirm() or dialog guards check, edit, stop, filter or download
No optimistic updates: review renders only after validateImport resolves (414-438) and progress shows only what onProgress reports (517-518)
No modal dialogs: no <dialog>, showModal, alert or confirm in lines 109-661
No modal dialogs: no <dialog>, showModal, alert or confirm in lines 109-661

lines 110-138: after the h1 and a one-line step list the first block is the file and paste inputs with the primary button; lines 142-169: review opens on the result heading, Import button and row table
lines 110-119: heading 'Import contacts', a one-line step list, then the form; no hero, greeting or introductory panel

lines 444-463: 'N of M rows can be imported', the problem count and the filter counts inform the go-ahead decision; lines 501, 540-549: imported and remaining counts inform resume or fix. No decorative metrics
lines 149-154, 461-464: the active filter is an always-visible radio group with counts; 'All (N)' is the single action that clears it; line 487: 'Showing X of Y rows' gives the result count

lines 122, 128, 133-153, 172, 183-192: all controls are native file input, textarea, radios and buttons; drag and drop (608-614) duplicates the file input; lines 386, 564, 627-628 manage focus; no focus trap

lines 483-484: each row's status is text ('Ready' or the problem naming the field); line 476: empty flagged cells read 'missing'; line 66: errors prefixed 'Problem:'; line 85: flagged cells also get an inset bar; line 36: current step is bold and underlined

No accordions, menus, comboboxes or tabs; the filter is a native radio group (149-154) and Show more appends rows (625-629)
